# KAM Global AI

> KAM Global AI provides technology engineering, creative production, business outsourcing, HR solutions for employers, and education technology. Technology work is coordinated from India. Business operations support is coordinated from the Philippines. Scope, hours and commercial terms are agreed before work starts.

## Who should use which page
- Clients looking for a service: [How a client engagement works](https://kamglobalai.com/about#for-clients), then [Services](https://kamglobalai.com/services)
- Partners: [How a partnership starts](https://kamglobalai.com/about#for-partners)
- People looking for a job: [Careers](https://kamglobalai.com/careers) — the only list of open roles, grouped by service

## Services
- [All services](https://kamglobalai.com/services): five divisions, search, and engagement overview
- [IT & Technology](https://kamglobalai.com/services/it-technology): consulting, software, web, mobile, APIs, design, data, AI applications, enterprise systems, cloud, DevOps, quality assurance, application security, maintenance, support, staffing and BOT
- [AI Media & Creative](https://kamglobalai.com/services/ai-media-creative): brand, design, video, motion, AI-assisted content, social, SEO content and campaign operations. Rankings, leads and advertising returns are not guaranteed
- [Business Outsourcing](https://kamglobalai.com/services/business-outsourcing): engineering outsourcing, data operations, BPO, customer support, sales support, finance administration, recruitment outsourcing, research, virtual assistance, e-commerce and education operations
- [HR Solutions](https://kamglobalai.com/services/hr-solutions): employer recruitment, contract staffing, executive search, payroll administration and HR systems. Not a job board
- [EdTech](https://kamglobalai.com/services/edtech): learning platforms, school software, and the LearnX.school and EduAiTutors products

## Products
- [LearnX.school](https://kamglobalai.com/products/learnx): school ERP, LMS and AI Academic Studio
- [EduAiTutors](https://kamglobalai.com/products/eduaitutors): tutoring for NEET, JEE and foundation learners
